scope: All remaining BP-OSD endpoint arms and X/Z finite bias families at both plot eta3 and methods eta5; preserved pure-X and initial pure-Z stay separate.
resources: At most two family workers plus the existing single pure-Z process: three CPU workers, each 2GiB address-space cap and2400 CPU seconds; host cgroup4CPU/16GiB. Per-condition deterministic checkpoints.
pilot: families-pilot.json: native engine L10 measured about .005–.05 seconds per trial depending on family; pilot excludes production.
uncertainty: Before examining family fits: 82 prospective precise-source comparisons (24 sourced BP families×3,3 SweepMatch families×3,1 undeformed cubic pure-Z scalar) use global Bonferroni alpha=.05. Four eta5 families have no source point. Deformed cubic pure-Z bound is not an exact comparison. Six cross-code rankings (Z eta30/100, rhombic undeformed versus each other code/deformation) form a separate alpha=.05 Bonferroni family. Preserved stage1 three-comparison family remains separately labeled historical analysis. Fit-boundary/failed replicates withhold inference; bootstrap is conditional and excludes unknown original uncertainty.
